Definition: properly, to vanquish; by implication, to rule (causatively, crown)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be or act as prince, rule, contend, have power, prevail over; 1a) (Qal) to rule over, govern; 1b) (Hiphil) to make rulers, play the prince
